$comment: Komodash Starter config per ADR-0010. Written by the First-run wizard (#23) when an End user has no existing komorebi.json. Differs from `komorebic quickstart` on: mouse_follows_focus=true, animation.enabled=true with friendly timing, border on with distinct focused colour, and a baked-in floating_applications entry for komodash.exe so the dashboard window itself doesn't get tiled (which causes focus-chain weirdness when clicking workspace buttons inside Komodash — see issue #20 smoke-test feedback).
